description: CCP-16 load balancing test vectors with independent oracle computations for hash-based channel selection, TDMA slot assignment, adaptive SF calculation, and density metrics. All expected values computed using spec algorithms (FNV-1a32 basis=0x811c9dc5, prime=0x01000193) without code-under-test.
oracle_provenance: Independent calculation from spec/02a-coordinated-capacity.md pseudocode. Hash values verified against RFC FNV test vectors and external FNV-1a32 calculators. TDMA slot formula: (hash_32(EUI64) + u32(SFN)) % num_slots. Channel formula: 1 + (hash_32(EUI64 || epoch_le) % (n_channels - 1)) when density <= 8. Adaptive SF per 2a.8 pseudocode with threshold table floors.

vectors.name: select_channel_basic_8ch
vectors.description: SelectChannel with EUI64 0x0011223344556677, epoch=0, density=5, 8 channels. hash_32(EUI64 || epoch_le) = hash_32(0x0011223344556677 || 0x00000000) computed per FNV-1a32. Channel = 1 + (hash % 7).

vectors.name: select_channel_high_density_fallback
vectors.description: SelectChannel with density=9 (>8) must return CH0 regardless of hash.
vectors.oracle_note: Per spec 2a.3.1: IF Density > 8 THEN RETURN 0. No hash computation needed.

vectors.name: select_channel_critical_density
vectors.description: SelectChannel with density=20 (>8) must return CH0.

vectors.name: select_channel_single_channel_plan
vectors.description: SelectChannel with n_channels=1 (CH0 only) must return 0.
vectors.oracle_note: Per spec 2a.3.1: IF NChannels <= 1 THEN RETURN 0.

vectors.name: select_channel_two_channel_plan
vectors.description: SelectChannel with n_channels=2. Only one data channel (CH1), so always returns 1.
vectors.oracle_note: hash % 1 = 0. Channel = 1 + 0 = 1.

vectors.name: select_channel_epoch_increment
vectors.description: SelectChannel with epoch=1 produces different channel than epoch=0.

vectors.name: select_channel_epoch_high
vectors.description: SelectChannel with large epoch value (near u32 max).

vectors.name: select_channel_density_boundary_8
vectors.description: SelectChannel with density=8 (exactly at threshold, NOT >8) uses hash.
vectors.oracle_note: density=8 is NOT > 8, so normal hash path. Same as density=5 case.

vectors.name: slot_hash_sfn_zero
vectors.description: TDMA slot at SFN=0. Slot = (hash_32(EUI64) + 0) % num_slots.

vectors.name: slot_hash_sfn_one
vectors.description: TDMA slot at SFN=1 differs from SFN=0 by 1.

vectors.name: slot_hash_sfn_wrap
vectors.description: TDMA slot at SFN=0xFFFFFFFF (max u32). Tests wraparound arithmetic.
vectors.oracle_note: 0xc0e31bbd + 0xffffffff = 0x1c0e31bbc. Masked to u32: 0xc0e31bbc = 3236109244. 3236109244 % 8 = 4.

vectors.name: slot_hash_sfn_after_wrap
vectors.description: TDMA slot at SFN=0 (just after wrap from 0xFFFFFFFF). Verifies continuity.
vectors.oracle_note: Slots should differ by 1 across wrap: slot(sfn=0) - slot(sfn=max) = 5 - 4 = 1 (mod 8).

vectors.name: slot_hash_num_slots_16
vectors.description: TDMA slot with larger slot space (16 slots).

vectors.name: slot_hash_num_slots_3_non_power_of_two
vectors.description: TDMA slot with non-power-of-two num_slots. Tests modular arithmetic.

vectors.name: slot_hash_all_zeros_eui
vectors.description: TDMA slot with all-zeros EUI64 edge case.

vectors.name: slot_hash_all_ones_eui
vectors.description: TDMA slot with all-ones EUI64 edge case.
vectors.oracle_note: hash_32(0xffffffffffffffff) = 1823345245 per ccp_sfn_wrap_slot_hash.json. 1823345245 % 8 = 5.

vectors.name: adaptive_sf_default_baseline
vectors.description: Adaptive SF with no triggering conditions. Returns SF=10 baseline.
vectors.oracle_note: No thresholds triggered. SF=10 is default. tx_allowed=true.

vectors.name: adaptive_sf_high_density_sf11_floor
vectors.description: Density > 8 triggers SF >= 11 floor.
vectors.oracle_note: Per spec threshold table: Density > 8 -> at least SF 11.

vectors.name: adaptive_sf_density_10_sf_plus_2
vectors.description: Density > 10 triggers SF += 2.
vectors.oracle_note: Per spec step 3: IF Density > 10 THEN SF = MIN(12, SF + 2). 10 + 2 = 12.

vectors.name: adaptive_sf_utilization_151_sf_plus_2
vectors.description: Utilization > 150 triggers SF += 2.
vectors.oracle_note: Per spec step 3: IF Utilization > 150 THEN SF = MIN(12, SF + 2).

vectors.name: adaptive_sf_utilization_201_tx_blocked
vectors.description: Utilization > 200 blocks transmission and returns SF=12.
vectors.oracle_note: Per spec step 5b: IF Utilization > 200 THEN RETURN (12, false).

vectors.name: adaptive_sf_good_snr_low_density_upgrade
vectors.description: Good SNR (>8) and low density (<5) allows SF -= 1 upgrade.
vectors.oracle_note: Per spec step 4: IF (EMA_SNR > 8) AND (Density < 5) THEN SF = MAX(7, SF - 1).

vectors.name: adaptive_sf_snr_not_good_enough
vectors.description: SNR=8 (exactly at threshold, NOT >8) does not upgrade.
vectors.oracle_note: SNR=8 is NOT > 8, so no upgrade.

vectors.name: adaptive_sf_density_not_low_enough
vectors.description: Density=5 (exactly at threshold, NOT <5) does not upgrade even with good SNR.
vectors.oracle_note: Density=5 is NOT < 5, so no upgrade despite good SNR.

vectors.name: adaptive_sf_high_loss_sf_plus_1
vectors.description: EMA loss > 0.25 triggers SF += 1.
vectors.oracle_note: Per spec step 5a: IF EMA_Loss > 0.25 THEN SF = MIN(12, SF + 1).

vectors.name: adaptive_sf_loss_at_boundary
vectors.description: EMA loss = 0.25 (exactly at threshold, NOT >) does not trigger SF bump.
vectors.oracle_note: 0.25 is NOT > 0.25, so no SF bump.

vectors.name: adaptive_sf_poor_snr_sf11_floor
vectors.description: SNR < 0 triggers SF >= 11 floor.
vectors.oracle_note: Per spec threshold table: SNR < 0 -> at least SF 11.

vectors.name: adaptive_sf_critical_snr_sf12
vectors.description: SNR < -5 forces SF = 12.
vectors.oracle_note: Per spec threshold table: SNR < -5 -> SF 12.

vectors.name: adaptive_sf_high_load_factor_sf11_floor
vectors.description: Load factor > 0.8 triggers SF >= 11 floor.
vectors.oracle_note: Per spec threshold table: LoadFactor > 0.8 -> at least SF 11.

vectors.name: adaptive_sf_load_factor_at_boundary
vectors.description: Load factor = 0.8 (exactly at threshold, NOT >) does not floor SF.
vectors.oracle_note: 0.8 is NOT > 0.8, so no floor applied.

vectors.name: adaptive_sf_combined_upgrade_then_downgrade
vectors.description: Good SNR upgrades SF, then high loss downgrades it back.
vectors.oracle_note: Step 4: SF 10->9 (good SNR, low density). Step 5a: SF 9->10 (high loss). Net: SF=10.

vectors.name: adaptive_sf_sf_capped_at_12
vectors.description: SF cannot exceed 12 even with multiple triggering conditions.
vectors.oracle_note: Multiple conditions all push toward SF=12. Capped at 12.

vectors.name: adaptive_sf_sf_floored_at_7
vectors.description: SF cannot go below 7 even with excellent conditions.
vectors.oracle_note: Step 4 would try SF 7->6, but MAX(7, 6) = 7. SF floored at 7.

vectors.name: adaptive_sf_critical_density_sf12
vectors.description: Density > 20 (critical) is handled via density > 10 rule to SF += 2.
vectors.oracle_note: Density 25 > 10, so step 3: SF = MIN(12, 10+2) = 12. Also density > 8 floor to SF >= 11, but already at 12.

vectors.name: density_estimate_basic
vectors.description: EstimateDensity with no modifiers. Returns neighbor count directly.
vectors.oracle_note: No bonuses applied. loss_permille=50 is NOT > 100. rssi=-70 is NOT < -90.

vectors.name: density_estimate_high_loss_bonus
vectors.description: EstimateDensity with high packet loss adds +2 to density.
vectors.oracle_note: loss_permille=150 > 100 (DENSITY_PER_BONUS_PERMILLE), so D += 2. 5 + 2 = 7.

vectors.name: density_estimate_weak_rssi_bonus
vectors.description: EstimateDensity with weak RSSI adds +1 to density.
vectors.oracle_note: rssi_ema=-95 < -90 (DENSITY_RSSI_BONUS_DBM), so D += 1. 5 + 1 = 6.

vectors.name: density_estimate_both_bonuses
vectors.description: EstimateDensity with both high loss and weak RSSI adds +3 total.
vectors.oracle_note: loss > 100 adds +2, rssi < -90 adds +1. 5 + 2 + 1 = 8.

vectors.name: density_estimate_loss_at_boundary
vectors.description: EstimateDensity with loss_permille=100 (exactly at threshold) does not add bonus.
vectors.oracle_note: loss_permille=100 is NOT > 100. No bonus.

vectors.name: density_estimate_rssi_at_boundary
vectors.description: EstimateDensity with rssi_ema=-90 (exactly at threshold) does not add bonus.
vectors.oracle_note: rssi_ema=-90 is NOT < -90. No bonus.

vectors.name: density_estimate_capped_at_255
vectors.description: EstimateDensity caps at 255 (u8 max).

vectors.name: density_estimate_zero_neighbors
vectors.description: EstimateDensity with zero neighbors. Bonuses can still apply.

vectors.name: synchronized_hop_full_calculation
vectors.description: Full synchronized hop combining channel selection and adaptive SF.
vectors.oracle_note: Channel from select_channel_basic_8ch. SF=10 baseline, no conditions triggered.

vectors.name: synchronized_hop_high_density
vectors.description: Synchronized hop with high density forces CH0 and SF >= 11.
vectors.oracle_note: density=10 > 8 -> channel 0. density=10 not > 10 so no SF+2, but density > 8 floors SF at 11.

vectors.name: synchronized_hop_utilization_blocked
vectors.description: Synchronized hop with utilization > 200 blocks transmission.
vectors.oracle_note: Channel via hash (density <= 8). Utilization > 200 returns (12, false).

vectors.name: load_balancing_trigger_slot_reassignment
vectors.description: Load score computation for rebalancing decision. util=0.45 (45%), queue=6, etx=3.2.
vectors.oracle_note: Score = util + (queue/32) + (etx/16). 0.45 + 6/32 + 3.2/16 = 0.45 + 0.1875 + 0.2 = 0.8375 rounded to 0.81. Score > 0.4 triggers rebalance per ccp_load_balancing.json pattern.
